person_onboarding_fields_check.name: person_onboarding_fields_check
person_onboarding_fields_check.value: "person"."onboarding_status" = 'begonnen' or ("person"."calculation_sex" is not null and "person"."birth_date" is not null and "person"."height_cm" is not null and "person"."activity_level" is not null and "person"."pregnant_or_breastfeeding" is not null and "person"."known_eating_disorder" is not null and "person"."disclaimer_accepted_at" is not null)

weekly_plan_day_bausteine_check.name: weekly_plan_day_bausteine_check
weekly_plan_day_bausteine_check.value: "weekly_plan_day"."baustein_1" in ('ernaehrung_erfasst', 'im_kalorienbudget', 'wasserziel', 'sporteinheit', 'gewogen') and "weekly_plan_day"."baustein_2" in ('ernaehrung_erfasst', 'im_kalorienbudget', 'wasserziel', 'sporteinheit', 'gewogen') and "weekly_plan_day"."baustein_3" in ('ernaehrung_erfasst', 'im_kalorienbudget', 'wasserziel', 'sporteinheit', 'gewogen') and "weekly_plan_day"."baustein_1" <> "weekly_plan_day"."baustein_2" and "weekly_plan_day"."baustein_1" <> "weekly_plan_day"."baustein_3" and "weekly_plan_day"."baustein_2" <> "weekly_plan_day"."baustein_3"

nutrition_entry_ref_check.name: nutrition_entry_ref_check
nutrition_entry_ref_check.value: ("nutrition_entry"."food_ref_type" is null) = ("nutrition_entry"."food_ref_key" is null) and ("nutrition_entry"."food_ref_type" is null) = ("nutrition_entry"."snapshot_source" = 'ki') and ("nutrition_entry"."food_ref_type" is null or "nutrition_entry"."food_ref_type" = "nutrition_entry"."snapshot_source")

nutrition_entry_amount_check.name: nutrition_entry_amount_check
nutrition_entry_amount_check.value: "nutrition_entry"."base_amount" > 0 and "nutrition_entry"."base_amount" <= (case "nutrition_entry"."snapshot_base_unit" when 'g' then 5000000 else 5000 end) and "nutrition_entry"."display_amount_milli" > 0

nutrition_entry_values_check.name: nutrition_entry_values_check
nutrition_entry_values_check.value: "nutrition_entry"."snapshot_reference_amount" > 0 and "nutrition_entry"."snapshot_milli_kcal" >= 0 and "nutrition_entry"."snapshot_protein_mg" >= 0 and "nutrition_entry"."snapshot_carbs_mg" >= 0 and "nutrition_entry"."snapshot_fat_mg" >= 0 and "nutrition_entry"."total_milli_kcal" >= 0 and "nutrition_entry"."total_protein_mg" >= 0 and "nutrition_entry"."total_carbs_mg" >= 0 and "nutrition_entry"."total_fat_mg" >= 0

sport_entry_origin_fields_check.name: sport_entry_origin_fields_check
sport_entry_origin_fields_check.value: ("sport_entry"."origin" = 'manuell' and "sport_entry"."external_key" is null and "sport_entry"."source_app_id" is null and "sport_entry"."source_app_name" is null and "sport_entry"."hidden_at" is null) or ("sport_entry"."origin" <> 'manuell' and "sport_entry"."external_key" is not null and "sport_entry"."replaced_by_entry_id" is null and "sport_entry"."reactivated_at" is null)

weight_entry_origin_fields_check.name: weight_entry_origin_fields_check
weight_entry_origin_fields_check.value: ("weight_entry"."origin" = 'manuell' and "weight_entry"."external_key" is null and "weight_entry"."source_app_id" is null and "weight_entry"."source_app_name" is null and "weight_entry"."hidden_at" is null) or ("weight_entry"."origin" <> 'manuell' and "weight_entry"."external_key" is not null)

challenge_started_check.name: challenge_started_check
challenge_started_check.value: ("challenge"."started_at" is not null) = ("challenge"."status" in ('aktiv', 'geschafft', 'abgelaufen', 'beendet')) and ("challenge"."started_at" is null) = ("challenge"."ends_at" is null)

challenge_requirement_payload_check.name: challenge_requirement_payload_check
challenge_requirement_payload_check.value: ("challenge_requirement"."deleted_at" is null) = ("challenge_requirement"."required_count" is not null) and "challenge_requirement"."required_count" > 0

energy_booking_amount_check.name: energy_booking_amount_check
energy_booking_amount_check.value: case when "energy_booking"."type" in ('daily_goal_credit', 'daily_bonus_credit') then "energy_booking"."amount" = 1 when "energy_booking"."type" = 'counter_booking' then "energy_booking"."amount" <> 0 else "energy_booking"."amount" < 0 end

energy_booking_reference_check.name: energy_booking_reference_check
energy_booking_reference_check.value: ("energy_booking"."daily_goal_completion_id" is not null) = ("energy_booking"."type" = 'daily_goal_credit') and ("energy_booking"."island_object_id" is not null) = ("energy_booking"."type" in ('build_debit', 'upgrade_debit')) and ("energy_booking"."community_project_id" is not null) = ("energy_booking"."type" = 'project_contribution_debit') and ("energy_booking"."original_booking_id" is not null) = ("energy_booking"."type" = 'counter_booking')

island_hatched_check.name: island_hatched_check
island_hatched_check.value: ("island"."state" <> 'aktiv' or "island"."hatched_at" is not null) and ("island"."state" <> 'wartet_auf_rollen' or "island"."hatched_at" is null) and ("island"."hatched_at" is null) = ("island"."time_zone" is null)

island_object_field_uq.name: island_object_field_uq
island_object_field_uq.where: "island_object"."field_id" is not null and "island_object"."deleted_at" is null
